created_views.description: The view id each insert_view op minted, keyed by the op's position, such as /ops/0.

see_also.description: The operations the hint names, as data: each renders in the hint as its method and path with params substituted and `?k=v` query sorted by key, so a caller with tools instead of routes can find and replace it by op.

op.description: The operation's OpenAPI operationId, such as list_properties; absent means the request that produced this issue, resent with the query given, and the hint then spells only the query.

params.description: Path parameters by their OpenAPI name, each substituted into the path once and verbatim (no percent-encoding); one left out keeps its {name} placeholder in the hint for the caller to fill.

query.description: Query parameters to send with the operation, spelled in the hint as ?name=value pairs joined by & and sorted by name, values verbatim.

items.description: Count of the member objects a created collection holds, on every collection create

template.description: The template the new object started from, absent when it started from nothing.

blocks_added.description: How many blocks the template carried, counted before the object's layout runs and without its header: the title, description and featured properties every object carries. Absent on a dry run, which does not build the template, and zero is a real answer.

combined.description: True when this request sent blocks of its own, which follow the template's in the object.

name.description: Display name of the template, empty when it has none.

source.description: Who chose it: request when the create named it, type_default when the type's default_template did.

template.title: AppliedTemplate

type.description: type key of the created object
